scope_rule: Only fixed SolverVBD behavior is included; source support and runtime validation are separate.

representation.solver_coordinates: maximal body pose and world COM twist
representation.axes: authored joint-local axes; ROD anchor +Z is material tangent
representation.structural_rest: non-ROD uses initial model.body_q; drive/limit rest offsets capture model.joint_q
representation.constraint_model: default finite-material compliant ALM; not ideal hard constraints

types.structural_response: translation and locked angular directions are compliant
types.angular_history: unwrapped angle, relative per-step rotation < pi including prediction and corrections
types.runtime_evidence: basic.example_basic_joints; multiturn drive/limit tests remain to run

types.structural_response: locked translation and angular directions are compliant

types.relative_dofs: authored linear/angular axis count, at most six
types.angular_history: winding only when exactly one angular DOF; relative per-step rotation < pi

types.drive: target_ke/target_kd define material; target_q captures structural rest bend/twist
types.runtime_evidence: vbd.example_cable_bend_stiffness; stretch/shear/twist curves remain to run

types.reason: SolverVBD explicitly does not support DISTANCE

behaviors.joint_enabled: SUPPORTED, read live; notify JOINT_PROPERTIES to refresh derived conditioning
behaviors.drive_damping: absolute physical damping, not normalized damping ratio

particle_body_attachment.source_support: SUPPORTED, translational compliant penalty, both ends integrated by VBD

validation_policy: runtime_evidence names an entry point, not a PASS. Actual results are in reports/p0_reference/summary.json; per-feature physics, limits, drives, winding and restarts remain P1/P2/P7 checks.
